result.title: EvalRx: Agentic Diagnosis and Verified Repair of Foundation Models
result.comment: 23 pages. Technical report. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/evalvitals/evalrx
result.summary: Model evaluation reveals where models fail, but rarely why or whether a proposed fix genuinely works. We introduce EvalRx, an open-source agentic framework for statistically grounded model diagnosis and repair. EvalRx discovers systematic failure modes, explores candidate mechanisms, formulates falsifiable hypotheses, and verifies them by executing frozen, pre-specified tests before using supported diagnoses to guide tiered repair. Candidate repairs are validated against the unchanged model and promoted only when they improve the target behavior without unacceptable regression. Across language, vision-language, and audio-language settings spanning Gemini, Qwen, Gemma, and Nemotron, EvalRx improves performance in all 12 evaluated model family-modality combinations, with gains ranging from +1.4 to +10.9 percentage points (+5.8 points on average). These results show that model evaluation can serve not only to measure failures, but to support an auditable process for diagnosing and repairing them.

AI.brief_summary: EvalRx 是一个开源的 agentic 框架，用于对基础模型做统计化的失败模式诊断与修复：先探索候选机制、提出可证伪假设并用冻结的预设测试验证，再据此分层修复，且只在目标行为改善、回归可接受时采纳；在语言、视觉-语言与音频-语言共 12 个模型组合上报告 +1.4 至 +10.9 个百分点的提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「冻结测试 + 可证伪假设 + 采纳前回归核查」的诊断流程，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 内容是否真正被答案使用、干预修复是否带来副作用等评价设计问题，但原文并未研究 latent 推理状态本身。
